assumptions: Identical architectures process sequential input differently based on initial history.
Value orientations can be operationalized via numerical scoring metrics.
Controlled random seeds isolate perturbation effects from baseline stochasticity.
definition.falsification: If systems subject to identical perturbation profiles converge to indistinguishable value states within error margins under extended trials, the hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: Refined model of path-dependent value trajectory divergence under controlled stochastic perturbations, isolating non-linear amplification of early initial state differences over extended trial sequences.
definition.uncertainty: Exact functional form mapping initial perturbation magnitude to permanent value separation limits.
